source: Fal OpenAPI input/output schema 原样采集于 2026-09-10：https://fal.ai/api/openapi/queue/openapi.json?endpoint_id=fal-ai/qwen-image-edit-2511-multiple-angles。input 为依据字段表构造的宿主请求；submit/status/result 为 Fal 公共队列协议与该输出 schema 构造的离线夹具，非真实生成记录。

result.prompt: <sks> left three-quarter view low-angle shot medium shot

lora_scale.description: The scale factor for the LoRA model. Controls the strength of the camera control effect.
lora_scale.title: Lora Scale

negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.description: The negative prompt for the generation

zoom.description: Camera zoom/distance. 0=wide shot (far away), 5=medium shot (normal), 10=close-up (very close).
zoom.title: Zoom (Distance)

image_size.title: Image Size
image_size.description: The size of the generated image. If not provided, the size of the input image will be used.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: Whether to enable the safety checker. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.

additional_prompt.title: Additional Prompt
additional_prompt.description: Additional text to append to the automatically generated prompt.

horizontal_angle.description: Horizontal rotation angle around the object in degrees. 0°=front view, 90°=right side, 180°=back view, 270°=left side, 360°=front view again.
horizontal_angle.title: Horizontal Angle (Azimuth °)

vertical_angle.description: Vertical camera angle in degrees. -30°=low-angle shot (looking up), 0°=eye-level, 30°=elevated, 60°=high-angle, 90°=bird's-eye view (looking down).
vertical_angle.title: Vertical Angle (Elevation °)

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI.

num_inference_steps.description: The number of inference steps to perform.
num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps

image_urls.title: Image URLs
image_urls.description: The URL of the image to adjust camera angle for.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: The format of the output image
